text:
Amanda L.: quick preflight — need a fast pass on weights location + tokenizer oddities + golden prompt failures before we cut the deploy. S3 path I'm using: s3://redwood-models/phoenix-v2/2025-11-01/. Can someone confirm perms and whether the quantized .ptx files are present?
Raj P.: I can check perms now. I saw two files: phoenix-v2-fp16.bin and phoenix-v2-q8.ptx earlier. will validate ACLs.
infra-bot: detected: s3://redwood-models/phoenix-v2/2025-11-01/ -- public-access-block = true, bucket policy allows GetObject for role:redwood-serving-role but object ACLs show 'bucket-owner-full-control' missing on uploads. Recommend adding ACL or changing upload job.
Raj P.: thanks infra-bot. looks like the CI upload job (ci-upload/phoenix) forgot --acl bucket-owner-full-control after the quantization run. I'll patch the job in first pass and re-run upload.
Maria C.: tokenizer weirdness: when running tokenizer.encode on some golden prompts we see an extra leading <s> token for a subset of prompts. e.g.
```
>>> t.encode("Summarize: The quick brown fox...")
[64, 12, 345, ...]  # expected first token 12 but got 64 (extra BOS)
```
This breaks our structured output matcher because offsets shift. I traced it to tokenizers v0.9.1 vs v0.9.3; newer wheel strips special tokens differently.
Josh K.: hmm that will break tool-calling outputs too if indices get shifted. Which evals are failing?
eval-bot: nightly-regression (phoenix-v2): 14/120 golden prompts failing. top failure modes: structured-json mismatch (7), tool-call signature mismatch (4), truncated finish (3). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/phoenix-v2/2025-11-01/run-42
Amanda L.: for the tool-call signature mismatch — any concrete example?
Josh K.: example from failure log: expected tool call: `call_tool("lookup_price", {"symbol": "AAPL"})` but model emits `call_tool("lookup_price", "AAPL")` — argument should be object. Our function schema expects a dict for args. Looks like during generation the structured tool-call wrapper isn't being enforced. Could be from the tokenizer changes or a prompt-template mismatch. :bug:
Maria C.: I reproduced the tool-call variant locally when tokenizer added the extra BOS; when decoder alignment shifts it sometimes collapses the JSON wrapper. I'll prepare a quick patch that forces `function_args` serialization to be explicit JSON object (safe stringify) as a temporary guard.
Raj P.: infra fix pushed to ci-upload job; re-upload in progress. also noticed a missing .tokenizer.json file in the weights bundle for phoenix-v2 — the upload included phoenix-v2.tokenizer_v2 but our serving expects phoenix-v2.tokenizer.json. I'll add a symlink step in the upload pipeline.
Amanda L.: action items: 1) Raj — finish upload fix + add tokenizer symlink step. 2) Maria — patch serializer guard + run local golden tests. 3) Josh — coordinate eval rerun and update failing golden entries if they are false positives. ETA EOD?
Raj P.: on it. will ping here when upload completes. :shipit:
Maria C.: working on serializer patch now, will run subset of 120 golds and post diff. :eyes:
Josh K.: I'll queue a rerun once Raj confirms re-upload. If failures reduce to <5 we'll proceed with canary.
infra-bot: s3 upload complete for s3://redwood-models/phoenix-v2/2025-11-01/ — objects now have bucket-owner-full-control, added phoenix-v2.tokenizer.json symlink.
Raj P.: upload done, md5 checksums match CI artifacts.
Maria C.: ran 30/120 golds with serializer guard; failures dropped from 14 -> 6. attaching sample failing prompt lines: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/phoenix-v2/2025-11-01/sample-fails.txt
Amanda L.: good progress. Josh, kick the full eval when you can. Also can we add a lint check to CI that asserts tokenizer file exists and that tokenizer version matches runtime? small ticket please.
Josh K.: started full eval run (job #78). ETA ~45m. I'll post summary.
eval-bot: run #78 complete: 6/120 failures. breakdown: structured-json mismatch (3), truncated finish (2), tool-call arg-type (1). Detailed diffs in artifact: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/phoenix-v2/2025-11-01/run-78/diffs.json
Amanda L.: OK that's within canary tolerance. Proposed next steps: canary deploy to dedicated pool, enable strict function arg validator in the runtime temporarily, monitor latencies. Anyone object?
Raj P.: no objections. I'll schedule the canary deploy window.
Maria C.: suggest we also open a follow-up to upgrade tokenizers on serving nodes to v0.9.3 and add a test that reproduces the extra-BOS case. I'll file it.
Josh K.: agreed. will also add a post-deploy evaluation monitor to alert at 1% regression on gold set.
Amanda L.: thanks team. closing this thread once canary is live. ping here with canary URL and any regressions. :thumbsup:
